title: PS5 is getting a Crunchyroll anime hub in 2027 📺
subject: playstation
description:
Would you use an anime hub on your PS5? 👇

PlayStation CEO Hideaki Nishino announced at Crunchyroll's first Anime Future Forum that a dedicated Crunchyroll anime hub is coming to the PS5 main menu in spring 2027, to make it easier for PlayStation players to discover anime. Sony bought Crunchyroll in 2021, and the app is already on PS5.

Sources: Push Square (Oct 7, 2026), Insider Gaming (Oct 8, 2026), Variety
